name: Sub-level
description: A moving physics build, like an airship or submarine.

pages.title: Sub-level
pages.text:
A **sub-level** is a moving Aeronautics build: a chunk of world with mass. Ships, submarines and coaster carts are physics objects that float, tilt, fall and collide.\
\
The physics comes from the Sable library. Aeronautics Compatibility keeps other mods' blocks working on them.
